<article class="paper-card" id="data-difficulty-and-the-generalization-extrapolation-tradeoff-in-llm-fine-tuning">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.05</span>
    <span>监督微调方法</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Data Difficulty and the Generalization--Extrapolation Tradeoff in LLM Fine-Tuning</h3>
  <p>该论文系统研究监督微调中的基于难度的数据选择，指出不存在普适最优的数据难度。论文用分布内泛化与外推之间的权衡解释数据规模相关的最优难度，并发现随着数据预算增加，最优训练样本会逐渐转向更难样本。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12906" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="rethinking-generalization-in-reasoning-sft-a-conditional-analysis-on-optimization-data-and-model-capability">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.04</span>
    <span>监督微调方法</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT: A Conditional Analysis on Optimization, Data, and Model Capability</h3>
  <p>该论文挑战“SFT 只会记忆而 RL 才能泛化”的常见说法，发现带长链式思维监督的推理 SFT 也能跨域泛化。其泛化效果取决于优化动态、训练数据和基础模型能力三者的共同作用。</p>

<a class="resource-link" href="https://huggingface.co/collections/jasonrqh/rethink-sft-generalization" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/huggingface.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />Hugging Face</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="profit-leveraging-high-value-signals-in-sft-via-probability-guided-token-selection">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.01</span>
    <span>监督微调方法</span>
  </div>
  <h3>ProFit: Leveraging High-Value Signals in SFT via Probability-Guided Token Selection</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 ProFit，一种监督微调方法，通过 token 概率作为语义重要性代理并屏蔽低概率 token，缓解单参考答案过拟合。该方法让训练更聚焦核心逻辑内容，并在推理和数学任务上优于标准 SFT 基线。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09195" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="beft-bias-efficient-fine-tuning-of-language-models-in-low-data-regimes">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.09</span>
    <span>监督微调方法</span>
  </div>
  <h3>BEFT: Bias-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Language Models in Low-Data Regimes</h3>
  <p>该论文研究低数据场景中应微调哪些注意力投影偏置项，发现直接微调 value bias 通常优于微调 query 或 key bias。该结论在最高 6.7B 参数的 encoder-only 和 decoder-only 语言模型上均成立，也适用于加入 value bias 的无偏置模型。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15974" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
<a class="resource-link" href="https://github.com/whubaichuan/BEFT" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/github.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />代码</a>
  </div>
</article>
